c.tagline: Israel's Red Sea playground - year-round sun, coral reefs, and duty-free desert nights.

taxi.fareNote: Metered white taxis are standard - ask the driver to run the meter (moneh). The Gett app is the local ride-hailing option; Uber does not operate in Israel.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

avoid.reason: Safe resort; follow local security guidance

hood_desc: Eilat's flagship shore - a palm-lined promenade backed by the biggest five-star resorts (Herods, Dan, Royal Beach), with the main swimming beach, restaurants, and sunset views over the Red Sea. The classic first-timer base.
The inner saltwater lagoon ringed by hotels, the yacht marina, boardwalk bars, and the Ice Mall; buzzy day and night and walkable to just about everything.
A cluster of mid-range hotels, pubs, and nightclubs a short walk from the lagoon; the go-to for budget-conscious travelers who want nightlife on the doorstep.
The workaday downtown around HaTmarim Boulevard and the central bus station - hostels, cheaper hotels, supermarkets, and local eateries, about a 15-minute walk from the beach.
The quieter southern coast 5-7 km toward the Taba border, home to the Coral Beach Nature Reserve, the Underwater Observatory, and Eilat's best shore diving and snorkeling; low-key and reef-focused.
lodging: Royal Beach Eilat by Isrotel Exclusive

water.note: Desalinated tap water is safe, though many prefer bottled for taste.

transit.hours: Buses run roughly 6:00 AM to around midnight and do not operate on Shabbat (Friday evening to Saturday evening); taxis and the Gett app fill that gap.
transit.note: Eilat has no rail or metro; the city runs on Egged buses (line 15 to Coral Beach, line 30 to Ramon Airport), taxis, and the Gett app, plus easy walking along the beachfront.
transit.pay: Bus fares are paid with a Rav-Kav smartcard or contactless card (around ₪5-6 a ride); taxis run on a meter.

bus: Egged intercity lines 390/394 to Tel Aviv and Jerusalem (~4-5h)
train: No railway serves Eilat; a line has long been proposed but not built

transit.m: Egged bus 30 to the central bus station and hotel zone (~25 min)
Taxi to the hotel zone / North Beach (20-25 min)

tip.r: 10-12% is expected at restaurants and is often not included in the bill.
